subject.title: fix(plugins): bound before_tool_call hook with a default timeout

question: Should `before_tool_call` adopt this unconditional 15s fail-closed default timeout for existing plugins?
rationale: The code fixes a real unbounded wait, but it intentionally changes slow existing plugin handlers from eventual completion to denied tool calls after 15 seconds.

options.title: Accept 15s Default
options.body: Land this focused timeout-table fix and rely on existing per-registration or operator per-hook timeout overrides for known slow plugin policies.

options.title: Adjust Timeout Policy
options.body: Ask for a longer default or clearer upgrade guidance before changing default behavior for deployed `before_tool_call` handlers.

options.title: Defer Broader Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a broader plugin hook timeout policy before changing this tool-call gate.

recommendation.title: Accept 15s Default
recommendation.body: Land this focused timeout-table fix and rely on existing per-registration or operator per-hook timeout overrides for known slow plugin policies.
